newsitem.title: RUSSIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Rostelekom downgraded to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Rostelekom downgraded to hold.

text.p: Russia's international long-distance carrier Rostelekom faces at least two more years of static traffic volumes and declining financial performance, Flemings Securities said in a recent research note.
The report, which included a recommendation to hold Rostelekom shares, said revenue-boosting traffic was unlikely to improve before 1999, and depended on substantial restructuring in the sector.
"While its valuation multiples are not unattractive when compared with its emerging market peers, this evaporates once its near-term earnings growth prospects are taken into account," the note said.
It forecast real revenues would slip by four percent in 1997 and two percent in 1998, while real earnings would drop by 12 percent in 1997 and another 10 percent in 1998.

The note said the stock could rise further on speculative buying in the short term in the wake of last week's sale of a 25 percent plus one share stake in holding company Svyazinvest, and in anticipation of the launch of Rostelekom's planned level-two American Depositary Receipt programme.
